After the fire that devastated Barangay 27, Bacolod City, Philippines on September 12, this loyal dog refused to leave the ruins of the only home he had ever known.

On the first day, the BACH Project team tried to rescue him, but he ran back inside the charred remains, his heart still clinging to the memories of his family.

Days turned into nights, yet he stayed. His body tired, but his hope unbroken.

Finally, at around 9 p.m., he was found again, alive, still waiting faithfully where love once lived. He was rescued and is now safe at Juan Veterinary Clinic.

To his family: know that your dog’s loyalty is immeasurable. Through fire, fear, and emptiness, he waited. Through heartbreak, he still believed.

Because a loyal heart never stops waiting. ❤️

📍Bacolod City, Philippines
📷 BACH Project
